autoomen.chat.drank: [Auto Omen] Drank an Ominous Bottle %s (%s left)
autoomen.chat.paused: [Auto Omen] Paused: the last %s bottles did not start a raid. Press the toggle key twice (or switch it off and on in the settings) to continue.
autoomen.config.title: Auto Omen Settings
autoomen.config.enabled.tooltip: Drink an Ominous Bottle from the inventory whenever the next raid can be started. Can also be switched with the toggle key (unbound by default, see Controls).
autoomen.config.timing.safe.tooltip: Drink once the raid boss bar has disappeared (the old raid is gone). The next raid starts about 30 seconds later.
autoomen.config.timing.early.tooltip: Drink as soon as the boss bar shows "Raid - Victory" or "Raid - Defeat". The new raid then begins right after the old one is removed, about 30 seconds sooner than "After the raid".
autoomen.config.priority.lowest.tooltip: Drink the lowest level bottle first.
autoomen.config.priority.highest.tooltip: Drink the highest level bottle first.
autoomen.config.priority.specific.toolti: Only drink bottles of the level chosen on the right. Other bottles are left alone.
autoomen.config.level.tooltip: The bottle level used with "Only one level".
autoomen.config.min_health.tooltip: No bottle is drunk while your health is lower than this.
autoomen.config.chat_notice.tooltip: Show one line in chat after each bottle.
